findings.evidence: `git diff --check` flags every touched line in these 2 files as 'trailing whitespace'. Root-caused via `git show HEAD:<file>` byte inspection: design_layer.dart's HEAD blob already has literal CRLF (83 CR = 83 LF = 83 CRLF) and custom_design_repository.dart's HEAD blob is already mixed (18 CR vs 25 LF) - both predate this session's edits. Because the committed blob itself carries raw \r bytes (not LF-normalized like every other file in this repo), any diff touching these files surfaces \r at line-end, which git's default core.whitespace rules (no cr-at-eol exception configured) classify as trailing whitespace. No line in this phase's added content has genuine trailing spaces/tabs; verified via direct content inspection of every flagged line.
findings.why_it_matters: This is pre-existing repository debt in how these 2 files were previously committed (bypassing autocrlf LF-normalization), not something Phase 2 introduced. Mass-normalizing the files' line endings would touch every unrelated existing line, producing large unrelated diff noise - out of scope for this phase.
findings.required_action: None for this phase. Consider a dedicated repo-hygiene pass (outside this feature) to renormalize these 2 files' line endings via `git add --renormalize` if the team wants git diff --check clean going forward.
